_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY — not active. Copy blocks into .claude/settings.local.json to enable. Each hook is optional; none are installed by default because a badly-scoped hook blocks normal development.

_hook_1_typecheck_after_edit._why: Catches type errors at edit time instead of at build time. Cheap and safe.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx)$'; then npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20; fi

_hook_2_secret_scan_before_commit._why: The highest-value hook here. Blocks .env files and live credentials from being committed. Public IDs (GTM-, G-, Meta Pixel, facebook-domain-verification) are deliberately NOT matched — they belong in code.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git commit'; then git diff --cached --name-only | grep -qE '^\.env' && echo 'BLOCKED: .env staged' && exit 2; git diff --cached | grep -qEi 'webhook\.discord|api[_-]?key\s*[:=]\s*.{15,}|IGQ[A-Za-z0-9]|AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{30,}|gho_|ghp_' && echo 'BLOCKED: possible secret in diff' && exit 2; fi; exit 0

_hook_3_sitemap_check_after_content_chan._why: The soft-404 bug produced clean builds while 16 pages were invisible. This surfaces a collection silently contributing zero URLs.

hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | grep -qE '^(data/|app/sitemap\.ts|keystatic\.config\.ts)'; then echo 'Content or schema changed — rebuild and verify sitemap count before pushing.'; fi

_hook_4_analytics_guard._why: Prevents a second GA4 loader or a direct gtag/fbq call sneaking in, which would double-count every event.

hooks.command: grep -rn --include='*.tsx' --include='*.ts' -E '(^|[^.a-zA-Z])(gtag|fbq)\(' app components 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'lib/analytics' && echo 'WARNING: direct gtag/fbq call — all events must go through lib/analytics.ts' || exit 0

_permissions_note: The active .claude/settings.local.json already allows tsc and next build. Consider adding read-only helpers you use constantly, e.g. Bash(git status *), Bash(git diff *), Bash(curl -s https://pahariyatri.com/*).
_do_not_add: Any hook that auto-commits or auto-pushes.
Any hook that posts to Discord, Instagram or LinkedIn.
Any hook that runs a full production build on every edit — too slow to work with.
